主要内容: ASML Holding N.V. filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on February 11, 2015. The filing includes the Statutory Annual Report 2014, Remuneration Report 2014, Corporate Responsibility Report 2014, and a press release announcing the publication of the 2014 Annual Reports. The report was signed by Peter T.F.M. Wennink, the Chief Executive Officer of ASML Holding N.V., on February 10, 2015. This filing is part of ASML's compliance with U.S. securities regulations and provides detailed information about the company's financial and operational performance for the year 2014.
